liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ice Castles** (1 other source): Ice Castles runs straight into The Final Alarm, marked as a segue [2]
- **Sarah** (1 review): Reviewer was astonished that Sarah was played [7]
- **The Mollusk** (1 other source): The piano interlude after Roses Are Free leads directly into The Mollusk [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **Fancy Pants**: rare: 8 archived performances [11]
- **Dont Sweat It**: back after 75 archived shows (1091 days) [11]
- **Sarah**: back after 150 archived shows (2212 days) [11]
- **Bannanas and Blow**: back after 118 archived shows (1662 days); rare: 6 archived performances [11]
- **Push th' Little Dasies**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **Roses are Free / Piano Interlude**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **Pusher Man Intro/LMLYP**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]

## The recordings

- **ween2010-10-31.mc930.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 35 songs; 192 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the recording A+ and guesses it may be front-of-board; the bass runs slightly low [4]
- **ween2010-10-31.mbho.flac16**: source not stated; 36 songs; 192 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **ween2010-10-31.mbho.flac24**: source not stated; 36 songs; 192 min [3]

## Around the show

- The encore begins with Mister, Would You Please Help My Pony?, after Blarney Stone ends the main set [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2010-10-31.mc930.flac16**: taped by Mike B; transferred by Mike B; source: Beyerdynamic MC930 > Kind Kables > Fostex FR2LE (@24/48) [1]
- **ween2010-10-31.mbho.flac16**: taped by Eric Foelske; source: MBHO 603a>actives>KA500N > V3 > DR-680 ** 16 Bit/CD ** [2]
- **ween2010-10-31.mbho.flac24**: taped by Eric Foelske; source: MBHO 603a>actives>KA500N > V3 > DR-680 ** 24 Bit ** [3]
